build_metrics_server: build a python module to create a gRPC MetricsServer that publishes stress test QPS data
create_MetricsServer: create a MetricsServer instance with a histogram to track queries per second for stress testing
test_GetAllGauges: test the MetricsServer GetAllGauges method to return all gauge responses including python_overall_qps
test_GetGauge: test the MetricsServer GetGauge method to return a specific gauge by name or raise an exception
review_get_qps: review the MetricsServer _get_qps method to calculate QPS from histogram count and time delta
